reasons: Your love will grow a little stronger with every sunrise you share.
The distance between you is temporary. The love between you is forever.
A day is coming when goodbye will only mean "see you in the next room".
You two will laugh together long after your hair turns silver.
Every promise made in this love will be kept, one by one.
Your hearts already found home. Soon your hands will too.
Years from now, you will still choose each other every single morning.
The best chapters of your story have not been written yet.
Your love will be the kind other people tell stories about.
A lifetime of slow mornings and shared cups of tea is waiting for you.
Whatever storms come, you will face them side by side.
The first hug will be worth every day you waited for it.
Your love will stay as gentle in fifty years as it is today.
Happiness is planning to move in with you both, permanently.
You will build a home full of laughter, music and warm light.
Every year together will feel like the luckiest one yet.
Your love will outlast every kilometre and every time zone.
One day you will walk the same streets, hand in hand, without counting the days.
You will grow old together, and still flirt over breakfast.
The universe is quietly arranging the day you finally meet.
Your bond will only deepen with every season that passes.
Your families will one day sit at one table, celebrating you two.
You will always be each other's safest place.
The waiting will end, and the forever will begin.
Your love will make ordinary days feel like festivals.
You will keep finding new reasons to fall for each other.
Peace, patience and kindness will follow your love wherever it goes.
Your names will look perfect written side by side, forever.
Every dream you dream together will find its way to you.
A future full of shared sunsets is already on its way.
Your love will be steady, like a lamp that never goes out.
You will celebrate many, many more anniversaries, each one sweeter.
No distance will ever be greater than your love.
Your story will end with "and they lived happily, together, always".
You will hold hands through every season of life.
The love you give each other will come back to you a hundredfold.
Your hearts will always speak the same language.
One day the screen will disappear, and only you two will remain.
Your love will grow deep roots and bloom every single year.
Together you will turn every "someday" into "today".
You will be each other's favourite hello and never a goodbye.
Your love will bring blessings to everyone around you.
Every year you will discover you love each other more than the last.
You are written in each other's destiny, in permanent ink.
A beautiful home with two names on the door is in your future.
Your love will stay young, even when you grow old together.
Every prayer you have made for each other is being heard.
Your hearts will beat side by side for a lifetime.
The best is not behind you. The best is waiting for you, together.
This love was meant to last forever, and it will.
